segments.title: Housing Market Dynamics
segments.content:
Around five in the evening, Li Luo carried the bowls and chopsticks to the dining table and sat down.

After the high school entrance exams ended, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong had only asked a few perfunctory questions.

When they realized they couldn't get any reliable answers out of Li Luo, they couldn't be bothered to ask anymore.

The exam results would be released at the end of the month anyway, which was only about two weeks away. The matter would be settled then.

At that time, regardless of whether he met the minimum score for a regular high school, they, as his parents, would definitely find a way to get Li Luo into one.

Having figured this out, the two of them stopped dwelling on the issue and shifted the topic at the dinner table to more important matters.

"I mentioned it to you last night. Wei Dongrong came to talk to me again today," Li Guohong said to his wife, smacking his lips as he ate. "His project sounds quite reliable. He said many relatives have invested. Why don't you go ask around these next few days?"

"Are you really going to invest?" Lin Xiuhong frowned.

On one hand, this was a project run by the husband of her rival, Zhang Xuefen.

On the other hand, they had originally planned to use this money for something else.

So Lin Xiuhong was still a little hesitant. "You'd better think this through. Our family isn't like theirs. This is all we have."

"Yes, I know." Li Guohong nodded. "That's why we have to be cautious. Let's ask around more. We can't just take their word for it."

"Even if the project really sounds good and we decide to invest, we'll definitely just put in a hundred thousand at first to test the waters."

"If it proves to be reliable later on, we can consider investing more."

"What you're saying makes sense," Lin Xiuhong said, still frowning. "But... what about your uncle's side? Didn't you say you were planning on taking over their house?"

"We did think about that before," Li Guohong said helplessly. "But you know how it is. For the past few months, housing prices in Yuhang City have been falling. If we take over now, what if the prices don't rise again in the future?"

Hearing his parents' conversation, Li Luo subconsciously stopped shoveling rice into his mouth.

He couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth, especially when he heard the last part.

In his past life, when his dad talked to him about investing in real estate projects, he never mentioned that the family had considered buying a house!

It was currently 2014. For the next five or six years, housing prices in Yuhang City were in a phase of explosive growth, rising from an average of around twelve or thirteen thousand to a high of twenty-five thousand.

Prices in some prime locations were even more outrageous.

If the family hadn't invested in his cousin-uncle Wei Dongrong's bullshit project back then and had instead used the money to buy a house, the return on investment would have been absurdly high.

At this thought, Li Luo felt a twinge in his teeth.

"I remember... isn't Third Grandpa's house in the village?" Li Luo asked tentatively in a low voice. "Are they selling the small villa they got from the village demolition?"

"Of course not." Li Guohong looked at his son, speechless. "That's the ancestral home, how could they sell it? They're selling a house by the Yinjiang River."

"By the Yinjiang River?" Li Luo blinked, thought for a moment, and then asked, "Isn't that the area next to the First Affiliated High School?"

"That's right." Li Guohong nodded. "Back when your cousin got into the First Affiliated High School, their family specifically bought a school district house there for him to live in."

"He's been graduated for two or three years now, right? Your cousin is planning to study abroad later, and that'll cost a lot of money, so they're thinking of selling this house."

"Besides, renting it out doesn't bring in much money for them, and they have to frequently change tenants, which is a big hassle."

Li Luo nodded in understanding, having roughly figured out the reason.

So back then, his parents thought the housing prices might continue to fall, so they chose the real estate project with a stable return on investment?

"And the location of that house is too remote," Li Guohong continued to elaborate, analyzing it for them. "The First Affiliated High School is already near the suburbs."

"Our Yinjiang District is already in the remote northeast of Yuhang City, and the First Affiliated High School is in the far north by the Yinjiang River, a good six or seven kilometers from the most prosperous part of the district."

"If it weren't near Qianjiang University and the First Affiliated High School, making it a school district house, who would buy it?"

"Besides, you can't get into these two schools just by buying a house there, can you? You still have to rely on your own ability to get in."

Hearing Li Guohong's explanation, Li Luo could understand.

After all, the area north of Yinjiang District was still in a phase of urban-rural integration. Many factories were located there, with a lot of migrant workers, and the environment was quite mixed.

But Li Luo knew very well.

In about half a year, Yinjiang District would begin planning the development of this northern area.

Two years later, a subway line would run from the center of Yuhang City directly to the northern suburbs of Yinjiang District.

The First Affiliated High School and Qianjiang University would be the final stops.

At the same time, the area south of Qianjiang University would become the future Times Tianjie commercial district, a place with massive foot traffic.

The housing prices nearby would also shoot up like a rocket, soaring from just over ten thousand to more than twenty thousand.

And at present, in Yinjiang District, ordinary people were completely unaware of all this.

People of Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong's social class were unlikely to have access to more information, so it was naturally difficult for them to imagine the rapid future development of the area north of Yinjiang District.

But in Li Luo's eyes, that was a huge treasure trove!

At this thought, Li Luo immediately set his mind to work, recalling every little detail from the past, hoping to find some useful information to persuade his parents.

At the very least, he had to make them hesitate about Wei Dongrong's project.

So, a few minutes later, as Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong continued to discuss the matter, Li Luo interjected again, "Dad, can I ask you a question?"

"What is it?" Li Guohong paused and turned to look at his son.

"I remember the subway at the South Station is about to open, right?"

"That's right." Li Guohong nodded. "It should be this summer vacation. In the future, you won't need to drive. You can just take the subway from the South Station and get to the city center in half an hour."

"Will the subway line be extended further in the future?" Li Luo asked, putting on a very innocent expression.

"I doubt it." Li Guohong frowned. "Our Yinjiang District is already so remote. It's good enough that the subway reaches the South Station."

"But..." Li Luo also frowned, a look of confusion on his face. "Dad, do you know the vice class president of my class?"

"What about him?"

"It's that Shao Heqi," Li Luo said with a serious face. "His dad is a government official."

"Oh, I have some impression of him." Li Guohong seemed to recall, having seen him at a parent-teacher conference before.

"Did you know?" Li Luo said enticingly. "Shao Heqi was showing off in class before and mentioned that his family recently bought a house near the First Affiliated High School. He even said it would definitely be a good investment."

"Hmm?" Li Guohong raised his eyebrows, his attention captured by Li Luo's words. "How so?"

"We were curious too, so we asked," Li Luo said, blinking. "He said his dad got some inside information. They say the subway from the South Station will be extended by three or four stops, and the final stop will very likely be Qianjiang University."

As soon as he said this, Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong fell silent.

They were both processing this news. After exchanging a glance, Li Guohong couldn't help but ask, "Did you hear that right? Is that really what your classmate said?"

"Yes." Li Luo nodded with a look of certainty, then asked curiously, "Dad, didn't you say before that after the subway was built at the South Station, the housing prices there went up a lot?"

"And just now you said Third Grandpa's house for sale is near the First Affiliated High School, which reminded me of this."

"As for Shao Heqi, many people in our class know that his family bought a house near the First Affiliated High School. Ying Chanxi, you heard him say it too, right?"

Ying Chanxi, who had been eating quietly on the side, heard Li Luo ask her, recalled for a moment, and then nodded. "Yes... I think he mentioned it at the beginning of the year."

He had definitely mentioned it.

After all, when Shao Heqi brought it up, he was standing right by Ying Chanxi's desk, deliberately bragging to another boy.

It would be strange if Ying Chanxi didn't know.

But.

Shao Heqi definitely hadn't mentioned the subway. That was all added by Li Luo.

However, what Li Luo asked Ying Chanxi was whether Shao Heqi's family had really bought a house there.

But it gave Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong the impression that Shao Heqi's family really knew that the subway would be extended there in the future.

He had instantly drawn his parents into this logical trap, and his words were starting to sway them.

One had to know.

For the past six months, the overall housing prices in Yuhang City had been slowly declining.

But in the area around the South Station in Yinjiang District, due to the opening of the subway line, the surrounding housing prices had risen instead of falling.

The current price of Li Luo's Third Grandpa's house was probably around eleven thousand, while the housing prices near the South Station subway stop had now risen to about fifteen thousand.

It was one of the few prime locations in Yinjiang District that hadn't fallen with the broader market.

If the subway line were to extend to the First Affiliated High School and Qianjiang University in the coming years, wouldn't that mean Third Grandpa's house had immense potential?

If the price increase was even half as much as the area around the South Station, the return would be far more attractive than the ten percent annual interest from Wei Dongrong's project.

However, Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong were not impulsive people.

Especially since this was just coming from a kid like Li Luo, they had to consider it carefully.

Buying a house was different from investing. Their family only had six or seven hundred thousand in total, all saved up through hard work over the past decade or so.

Wei Dongrong's investment was one thing; the minimum was only one hundred thousand, so the risk wasn't that great.

But once they decided to buy a house, even if it was Third Grandpa's second-hand house and the price was cheaper because they were in a hurry to sell,

it was still something Li Luo's family would need a mortgage to afford.

With six or seven hundred thousand for a down payment, they would have to take on a mortgage of at least a million.

If housing prices rose in the future, it would be fine.

But if prices fell, it would be a heavy blow to the entire family.

And once they took on a mortgage, the financial pressure on the family would naturally increase, and they would have to be more careful with their daily spending.

"If that's really the case, then your uncle's house isn't out of the question, is it?" Lin Xiuhong hesitated for a moment before saying to Li Guohong.

"Let's wait and see." Li Guohong's brow was tightly furrowed; he was also unsure. "In any case, I definitely have to go take a look at Wei Dongrong's project. I already promised."

"As for my uncle's side, I'll go take another look in a few days. And I'll ask around for any news about the subway."

He said that, but Li Guohong didn't expect to be able to find out anything about the subway line planning.

This kind of information was simply not something people of their level could obtain in advance.

If even he could find out, it meant that many people in Yinjiang District should already know.

On the contrary, there was no news on the surface right now, yet Li Luo's classmate Shao Heqi's family had bought a house near the First Affiliated High School and claimed that it would definitely be profitable and that the subway would extend there.

The more such unpublicized news seemed, the more it sounded real to Li Guohong.

As for Li Luo, he didn't say anything more for the moment.

Speaking as a child, he had said enough.

Pushing any further might have the opposite effect.

Today's probing was enough. He would slowly gauge his parents' opinions later and strive to dissuade them from investing in his cousin-uncle's real estate project.

"Sigh... If only Li Luo were a bit more promising." After chatting for a while, Lin Xiuhong suddenly said, "If you had managed to get into the First Affiliated High School, your dad and I would have bought your Third Grandpa's house, and you could have lived there while you were in school."

"True." Li Guohong smiled and chimed in, "That house is right across from the First Affiliated High School. It's only a few minutes' walk to school, very convenient. It would save you from having to squeeze into a dorm room."

Hearing this, Li Luo's eyes darted around. The thoughts he had planned to put to rest stirred again. He then coughed twice, "Can't you have a little more faith in me? What if I actually get in?"

"Ha." Li Guohong was so amused he laughed. "If you really have the ability to get in, I'll buy the house without a second thought! If you're really that promising, what wouldn't your parents agree to?"

Li Luo raised his eyebrows when he heard his dad say this, but he didn't provoke him further.

With his parents' words, they should be of some use once the exam results were out.

At this thought, Li Luo relaxed a little.

The family continued their meal. After finishing around six o'clock, Li Luo obediently got up and took the plates to the kitchen to wash the dishes.

"Did the sun rise from the west?" Lin Xiuhong looked at Li Luo with a surprised expression. "Why are you being so proactive today?"

"Of course, it's because your son has become sensible." Li Luo said cheekily, turning his head. "So Mom, when are you giving me my summer vacation allowance?"

"Get lost." Lin Xiuhong rolled her eyes. "If you had asked after you finished washing the dishes, I would've given you at least a little something."

Mother and son bickered through the kitchen door, while Ying Chanxi silently entered the kitchen and helped Li Luo wash the dishes.

After the kitchen was cleaned up, Li Luo patted Ying Chanxi's shoulder and said to her, "Your computer works, right? Let me use it for a bit later."

"Oh." Ying Chanxi nodded. "But don't play too late, or your mom will lecture you again."

"You're bossier than my mom," Li Luo pouted. "Just say I'm going to your place to study."

"As if anyone would believe you."
